name: allclear
description: Status page and basic availability monitor for Cloudflare's serverless platform

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/shared test && npm --prefix apps/api test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run build && npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck

comment: Deliberately NOT an npm workspaces monorepo. Each package installs its own dependencies. The M0 route validation showed that hoisting the beta vinext + @cloudflare/vite-plugin tree would add an unrelated variable to the one thing that milestone had to prove; that reasoning still holds, so the decision was revisited after M0 and kept. Consequence worth knowing: `packages/shared` must be built before anything that imports it can run, which is why `build` builds it first. `apps/api` has no build step of its own — `wrangler deploy` bundles it — so it appears in `test` and `typecheck` only. `typecheck` builds `packages/shared` first for the same reason `build` does: `apps/api` and `apps/web` both resolve `@allclear/shared` through its `exports` map to `dist/index.d.ts`, so without that step a change to shared source is type-checked against the previous build, and the gate reports on code that is no longer there.
